description: Replace the weekly posting queue slots for the global schedule or one account group (Pro feature; needs the schedule:write permission). Pass the FULL desired slot list — it replaces the existing one. An empty array on a group removes its override so it inherits the global schedule again.

groupId.description: Account group id (from list_account_groups); omit for the global schedule

slots.description: The complete weekly slot list to store

time.description: 24h time 'HH:MM' in the user's timezone, e.g. '09:30'

name: set_posting_schedule
